scheme_name: Biju Patnaik Sports Award for Lifetime Achievement in Promotion of Sports & Games
other_conditions: Must be a permanent resident of Odisha or have resided there for at least 7 years.
Must have demonstrated good performances at national and international levels and continued contribution to sports promotion after retirement.
Must be at least 45 years old as of 1st January of the award year.
Must not be found using prohibited drugs or banned substances.
Award can be given only once in a lifetime (except posthumously).
Award may be given posthumously to the next of kin.
Award may be cancelled and the awardee may be required to refund the cash award if obtained fraudulently.
benefits_summary: Cash award of ₹3,00,000 along with a statue, scroll of honour, blazer with tie, and travel and dearness allowances as per Grade A officer.
